_comment: Story shapes for the daily generated reel. The agent rotates through these so two reels never share a shape on consecutive days. Each shape has 2 or 3 footage beats; beat 1 is a fresh Veo generation, later beats extend that same clip so the person, room and light carry through. {persona} is filled from personas.json; {action} is the one line the writer adds for that beat. The product card (real interface) is cut in after 'card_after_beat', then the price card closes. Prompts never ask for readable text, logos or captions in the footage.
look: Vertical 9:16, photoreal handheld documentary footage, natural colour, shallow depth of field, an ordinary middle-class Indian home or hostel room. No text, no captions, no logos, no readable words anywhere in frame.
laptop: an open laptop whose screen shows a dark, tidy software panel with soft blue highlights, seen from an angle so nothing on it can be read

stories.name: The freeze
stories.summary: A candidate blanks on a question they know, glances at the laptop, recovers and answers well.

beats.frame: {look} {persona} sits at a small desk facing {laptop} during a video job interview. {action} They start to answer, stop, and look away searching for words. Close on the face, honest and unglamorous.
Same person, same room, no cut. {action} Their eyes drop to the laptop, a short breath, the expression settles, and they answer with quiet confidence, sitting straighter, gesturing lightly.

stories.name: The language switch
stories.summary: The interviewer switches to Hindi mid-question; the candidate registers it, then answers easily.

beats.frame: {look} {persona} in a video interview at a desk with {laptop}, listening, nodding along. {action} Then a flicker of surprise crosses the face, as if the question just changed language mid-sentence.
Same person, same room, no cut. {action} A glance at the laptop, a small smile, and they reply comfortably and warmly, hands moving naturally as they explain.

stories.name: The night before
stories.summary: Practising alone late at night with the app, then reviewing what was asked.

beats.frame: {look} Late night, a single desk lamp. {persona} sits alone with {laptop}, rehearsing answers out loud to an empty room, a little tired, determined. {action}
Same person, same room, no cut. {action} They lean back, scroll through something on the laptop with a satisfied nod, then close it gently and switch off the lamp.

stories.name: The morning of
stories.summary: Getting ready, sitting down, the call connecting, nerves, then the first small relief.

beats.frame: {look} Early morning light. {persona} irons a collar, sips chai, sits down in front of {laptop} and straightens up as a call connects. Nervous, hopeful. {action}
Same person, same room, no cut. {action} The first question lands, a beat of panic, then a glance at the laptop and a small exhale of relief as they begin to speak steadily.

stories.name: After the call
stories.summary: The interview ends, relief, a call to family, then reviewing every question that was asked.

beats.frame: {look} {persona} says a polite goodbye to {laptop}, closes it, exhales, and slumps back with relief, then reaches for a phone and smiles while talking to someone. {action}
Same person, same room, no cut. {action} They open the laptop again and read through something slowly, nodding, as if going over what was asked.

stories.name: Two candidates, one question
stories.summary: One candidate recites a memorised template stiffly; the same person, later, speaks naturally about their own project.

beats.frame: {look} {persona} in a video interview, reciting something memorised, stiff and monotone, eyes fixed and glassy. {action}
Same person, same room, no cut. {action} A shift: shoulders drop, a glance at the laptop, and now they talk about their own work with natural energy, hands moving, a real half-smile.

stories.name: Once, not monthly
stories.summary: The frustration of subscriptions that renew, versus paying once for the days you need.

beats.frame: {look} {persona} at a kitchen table scrolling a phone, frowning at it, then setting it face down with a sigh. Morning light, chai steaming. {action}
Same person, same room, no cut. {action} They pick the phone back up, tap once decisively, put it away, and turn to {laptop} with an easy, settled expression.

stories.name: Straight to camera
stories.summary: A young professional talks to the viewer like a senior giving advice; no interview scene.

beats.frame: {look} {persona} sits facing the camera in a plain room, talking directly to the viewer like a senior colleague giving honest advice, calm and warm, small natural hand gestures. {action}
Same person, same framing, no cut. {action} They gesture towards {laptop} beside them, then look back to the camera and finish the thought with a nod.

angles.resume_answers: Answers come from your own resume and projects, not a template, so you sound like yourself.
angles.hinglish: It follows the interviewer's language, English, Hindi or Hinglish, even when it switches mid-question.
angles.speed: The answer appears in about a second and a half, before the silence gets awkward.
angles.transcript: After the call you get a transcript and summary of every question, so you know what you were asked.
angles.practice: Use it as a practice partner: run mock questions, see strong answers, review afterwards.
angles.price: 30 minutes free with every feature, then a 2-day pass for 99 rupees. One-time. Nothing renews.
angles.free_minutes: 30 minutes free with every feature, no card, no signup.
angles.privacy: On your screen. Not in the meeting. It runs beside the call on your own Windows laptop, and what you see is yours.
